subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 28, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 28, 2026**

**Top Development:**

AcreetionOS has made significant strides in improving the user experience with the latest commit to the Calamares installer. Cobra3282000 has implemented a feature that forces Wayland as the default desktop environment, ensuring a smoother and more seamless user experience. This change will greatly benefit users who prefer the Wayland session over the traditional X11 session.

**Community News:**

The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to the project, with several community members working on various aspects of the distribution. Peter Robinson has written a blog post about the current state of Fedora support for Raspberry Pi 5, providing valuable insights for users interested in running AcreetionOS on this hardware.

**Practical Tip:**

For users who prefer the Cinnamon desktop environment, AcreetionOS now offers a more stable and efficient way to manage display settings. The latest commit to the Calamares-config-wayland repository includes a fix for the displaymanager job crash, ensuring that users can enjoy a smooth and trouble-free experience.

Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community, and don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server for support and discussion.
